notes.title: v1.1 + Level editor
notes.content:
Dear [b]Nekomew fans[/b],
Thanks for waiting during all this time. Finally, the game has been updated to [b]version 1.1[/b], which includes the following relevant fixes and changes:

[list]
[*]Skip musical notes in game results screen.
[*]UI improvements
[*]Main menu "Test screen" fix
[*]Results screen pause "back" fix
[*]Portuguese, French, German and Italian cutscenes fix
[*]Minor translation issues (characters, etc)
[*]Fix for quick input events.
[*]Specific level difficulty decreased & softlock levels fix
[*]Save backup feature
[/list]
Additionally, I'd like to announce that a [b]standalone windows level editor (BETA) [/b]has been also released here ([b]for FREE[/b]).
[url=https://pikewin.itch.io/nekomews-nightmares-level-editor]Click here to learn more about Nekomew's Nightmares Level Editor at itch.io[/url]

[previewyoutube=qfA78zC7d2Q;full][/previewyoutube]
Expect new updates to come in the future.

Thank you so much.
